channel.description: Latest articles from Revolutionary Communists of America (RCA) – Bias and Credibility (communistusa.org)

item.title: May Day 2026: Communists out in Record Numbers! - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: In the wake of Trump 2.0, the Iran war, and the Minneapolis General Strike, the RCA anticipated that this would be the biggest May Day in the US in living memory.

item.title: Ireland: Fuel Protests Show the Way - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: Dublin city center was at a standstill for almost a week as farmers and haulers who had been stretched beyond breaking point blocked the streets with their heavy vehicles. Farmers joked that they had done their friends in the Green Party a favor, having at last pedestrianized Dublin City center.

item.title: Trump and the Decay of US Bureaucracy - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: The character of the capitalist state’s administrators may seem to depend on the peculiarities of individual personalities. But beneath the surface, larger historical forces are at work.

item.title: Iran War Sparks Strike Wave in India - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has provoked an energy crisis in India. This sudden, huge increase in the cost of living has sparked a wave of strikes across the National Capital Region encompassing nearly a hundred thousand workers.

item.title: Trump’s $1.5 Trillion Military Budget: Warfare, not Healthcare! - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: To pay for more wars, Trump wants to slash domestic programs by 10%, or $73 billion. His proposed cuts include $5 billion from various healthcare programs, $8.5 billion from public schools, and $5 billion from medical research, among other things.

item.title: After Minneapolis, Lenin’s What Is To Be Done Hits Different - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: Six days after the Minnesota General Strike, I sat in a chilly community center lit by fluorescent light bulbs with over fifty other Minneapolis residents. The question of the hour was what next? How do we escalate the struggle?

item.title: The Gains of the Cuban Revolution - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: The Cuban Revolution has held on for nearly seventy years, right under the nose of the most powerful imperialist country on earth—which has tried every possible means to overthrow it.

item.title: Marxism and Armed Struggle - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: It’s easy to understand why so many radicalized workers and young people are attracted to armed struggle. They want to fight back in a direct and immediate way. Above all, they want to settle accounts with ICE.

item.title: Nepal’s "Gen Z" Election: What Next? - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: Six months ago, Nepal was in the midst of a revolutionary uprising, led primarily by the youth. The potential was there for Nepali workers and youth to take power into their own hands.

item.title: “Democratic Rights” under Capitalism: A Warning to the Working Class - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: In practice, every democratic freedom enshrined in the Bill of Rights, taken for granted by popular opinion as constitutionally guaranteed, has been systematically attacked by the capitalist government—without apology and without remorse.

item.title: Are the Black Panthers Back? - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: In January, scenes of Black Lion Party for International Solidarity (BLP) members carrying rifles at a Philadelphia anti-ICE demonstration were broadcast around the world, going viral on social media.

item.title: What Was the Postwar Boom? - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: Recorded on October 26th, 2025 at the Chicago Marxist School. In this talk, Bryce Gordon explains how capitalism got a new lease on life during the postwar boom—and why this historical anomaly will not be repeated. Follow us:

item.title: New START Expires: Welcome to the New Nuclear Era - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: The New START nuclear arms treaty between the US and Russia, originally signed in April 2010, expired last month, leaving the two countries with no agreement in place on their nuclear arsenals.

item.title: How the Global Crisis Is Strengthening Russia - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: At the center of the crisis lies the Strait of Hormuz, a key artery of the global energy system. While millions suffer, others profit. Paradoxically, one of the economic beneficiaries of the conflict may be Russia.

item.title: Capitalism Is Making Us Lonelier than Ever - Revolutionary Communists of America
item.description: A “relationship recession” is plaguing the world. The Economist reports that 41% of women and 50% of men between the ages of 23 and 34 were single in 2023—double the rate from 50 years ago.
